name: dogfood-deno-deploy-geo-app
description: Dogfood app v1.24-4 — a Deno Fresh app on Deno Deploy that exercises the geo-replicated axis (Deno KV strong consistency + multi-region write + eventual consistency observation) + edge-kv axis (read-your-writes + range query) + cron-trigger axis (Deno Deploy Cron scheduled + queue trigger + 24h retention purge) end-to-end.
